name: backup
title: Backup
description: Scheduled, in-deployment snapshots — a cron-driven internalAction that exports a configured set of tables to a timestamped NDJSON object in a dedicated R2 bucket. The point-in-time-recovery building block; pairs with `cirrus backup restore`.
docs: Register the snapshot on a schedule in cirrus/crons.ts: `crons.daily("backup snapshot", { hourUTC: 3, minuteUTC: 0 }, internal.backup.snapshot, {})`, then `cirrus codegen`. Edit the TABLES list in cirrus/backup/index.ts to cover every table you want backed up (codegen cannot enumerate tables for you). Add the BACKUP_BUCKET r2_buckets binding (added to wrangler.jsonc on install) and set retention yourself. Restore with `cirrus backup restore <id|file>`.
